decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records functional-prototype completion as the immediate priority and cosmetic refinement as later work.
The same-message DEFER and MODIFY already capture postponement of additional visual refinement until after receipt of the functional prototype.
The existing same-message DEFER already captures that decorative lighting is not part of immediate functional-prototype completion.
Deferring additional cosmetic refinement does not revoke or change the previously approved baseline beige-and-green color scheme.
The message preserves possible K button markings while moving additional industrial-design and cosmetic refinement later; this Requirement combines details that may therefore have different timing.

The pending additional-component obligation was introduced solely for decorative LEDs; deferring cosmetic refinement makes that immediate LED-selection obligation obsolete and requires cleaning the component-set status.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Larry,

Thank you for the update.

After reviewing our original project discussions and scope, I understand that the initial focus was primarily on the engineering, wiring, circuitry, prototyping, and functionality of the machine. As the project evolved, I became more focused on the aesthetic and branding aspects, but I can see how the original scope was centered more heavily on developing a functional prototype.

My primary concern at this point is ensuring that the machine is mechanically sound, reliable, and operates as intended. Functionality and performance are my highest priorities.

I would like to see the demonstration of the prototype as soon as it is available. Please include the machine operating under normal use conditions so I can evaluate the mixing performance, stability, and overall functionality.

Once I receive and review the demonstration, I would like to move forward with completing the remaining wiring, enclosure fabrication, and base fabrication so that the machine can be shipped.

Regarding aesthetics, I appreciate your willingness to incorporate the "K" button markings and discuss lighting options. I will likely pursue additional branding, industrial design, and cosmetic refinements separately after receiving the prototype, so my immediate focus is on getting a fully functioning machine completed and delivered.

Please provide the demonstration and an updated target ship date once the remaining work is complete.

value_updates.selected_component_set_status: The previously approved component set remains current for immediate functional-prototype completion; decorative LED selection is deferred with later cosmetic refinement.

decisions.reason: The branding-refinement timing decision does not alter sanitation, cleanability, or fluid-path requirements.
Prioritizing functional completion and later cosmetic refinement does not change the existing finalized system-layout deliverable.
Maintenance and service access remain required regardless of when additional branding or cosmetic work occurs.
The cosmetic-refinement timing decision does not modify the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The message prioritizes evaluation of mixing performance but does not change the required smooth, frothy mixing outcome.
Deferral of additional branding and cosmetic refinement does not change the approved bowl capacity or form.
